coverage.note: Phase 1: 53 base guns. Unique variants, melee and throwables excluded (no published stats).

weapons.name: Scorpio Nipper .38
notes: Cheapest gun. Price contested: IGN lists $495 (via gta6everything, checked 20 Nov 2026); GTA6Info, fpsgen and tracker.gg list $550.

weapons.name: Klose K17
notes: Lucia's pistol (Rockstar-named). Accuracy contested: howtovideogame's own PS5 recording reads 4.5, not 4.2.

weapons.name: Duke 1922
notes: Price marked disputed (*) in GTA6Info's own price table; fpsgen and vAnother Level (on screen) also list $1,050.
Extended magazine 8 to 36 rounds: GTA6Direct (via GTABase), single source.

weapons.name: Girardi ES9
weapons.unlock: Free via 'Unwanted Attention' mission; also sold for $700
notes: Jason's pistol (Rockstar-named).

weapons.name: Girardi ES18
notes: Accuracy/handling contested: Dexerto, fpsgen and The Games Wiki list 4.6 / 7.7; GTA6Info (DayOne), IGN, GTABase, guiasgta6 and Mobalytics list 4.4 / 8.2. Published as 4.4 / 8.2 (majority). Note: IGN lists the unique Guardian ES18 variant at 4.6 / 7.7, which may explain the split.
Price: GTA6Direct lists 'Price not published yet' while Dexerto, GTA6Info, fpsgen and GTABase list $1,550.

weapons.name: Klose K17 MCD
notes: Handling contested: Dexerto, fpsgen and The Games Wiki list 7.7; GTA6Info (DayOne), IGN, GTABase, guiasgta6 and Mobalytics list 8.0. Published as 8.0 (majority).

weapons.name: Schlamm DRX
notes: Named without stats in GTA6Info's Weapons_List; stats from Dexerto, fpsgen, The Games Wiki and IGN, all agreeing 4.0 / 4.2 / 8.2 / 4.2.

weapons.name: Fairview Kalinga .50
notes: Joint-hardest-hitting pistol (7.0 damage, shared with the Scorpio Akulus).

weapons.name: Scorpio Akulus
notes: Joint-hardest-hitting pistol (7.0 damage, shared with the Fairview Kalinga .50).

weapons.name: Hawk & Little Morgan
weapons.unlock: Ultimate Edition; unlocked at Ammu-Nation after the Chapter 2 mission 'Coffee Break' (reported)
notes: Ultimate Edition revolver (Rockstar-named); not sold at Ammu-Nation, so no standard price.

weapons.name: Vom Feuer VF5
notes: All 8 SMGs share Damage 4.2; they differ only on Accuracy / Handling / Range.

weapons.name: Wortham W-10
notes: Counts as a sidearm (small SMG) for the 2-sidearm carry limit.

weapons.name: Zhang Wu Type 9
notes: Counts as a sidearm (machine pistol) for the 2-sidearm carry limit.

weapons.name: Deever Tech DSG
notes: Counts as a sidearm for the 2-sidearm carry limit.

weapons.name: Vom Feuer VF5C
notes: Accuracy/handling contested: Dexerto, fpsgen and The Games Wiki list 4.0 / 7.9; GTA6Info (DayOne), IGN, guiasgta6 and Mobalytics list 5.0 / 6.9. Published as 5.0 / 6.9 (majority).

weapons.name: AdB PD-90
weapons.unlock: Buy 13 more weapons to unlock (Beebom, single source)
notes: GTA6Info's stats table names this gun 'AdB PD-80'; its own price table, Dexerto, fpsgen, The Games Wiki, tracker.gg and Beebom all call it PD-90. Roster uses PD-90.
Price marked disputed (*) in GTA6Info's price table; Dexerto, fpsgen, tracker.gg, The Games Wiki and Beebom all list $3,350.

weapons.name: Fortune & Son Moreland 850
notes: Sale price $350 is the first-visit / Gear Up mission price; standard price $700 (GamesRadar+; howtovideogame PS5 recording). fpsgen lists it as free in the story (given early in the story). fpsgen lists handling 5.2; vAnother Level read 5.6 on screen (MELOO, Ben-Gun), so 5.6 ships.

Attachment slots read on screen by vAnother Level (Moreland 850 Modify menu): Barrels, Foregrips, Forends, Iron Sights, Lights, Magazines, Muzzles & Suppressors, Optics, Pistol Grips, Saddles, Stocks.

weapons.name: Girardi AZ1200
notes: vAnother Level read 7.4 / 4.8 / 5.8 / 2.5 on screen, but noted the $3,460 menu price 'includes weapon and mods' — the 4.8 accuracy is a modded read. Stock accuracy 4.5 ships (GTA6Info, fpsgen).

weapons.name: Shrewsbury Drifter
notes: Double-barrel (side-by-side); the plan's earlier note that the Moreland 850 fires 'both barrels at once' is wrong — the Drifter is the double-barrel.

weapons.name: Goodwin Comshot 12
notes: Highest damage (7.7) of the magazine-fed shotguns.

weapons.name: Kozlov KVGA-12
notes: The only full-auto shotgun.

weapons.name: Kozlov KZ-59
notes: A unique zombie-artwork KZ-59 is sold only at Rodgers Ranch for $2,630, after gold on all its shooting ranges (GTA6Info) — a variant, not this base gun.

weapons.name: Hillinger Heathen
notes: Magazine size not published: GTA6Info lists '-', vAnother Level lists '?'. Left null, never guessed.

weapons.name: Duke 556
notes: Contested figure resolved: Dexerto, GTA6Info, vAnother Level (on screen), Exputer, guiasgta6, Pro Game Guides, gta6heists, The Games Wiki, libertycity, theleonida ('checked in the game on PS5, Nov 19') and MeowDB ('seen in gameplay') all agree 6.0 / 5.8 / 6.2. Beebom alone lists 6.8 / 5.0 / 5.8 — the outlier. RetroBroker notes early captures show range 5.5–6.2.

weapons.name: Kozlov Hind
notes: Accuracy/handling contested: Dexerto, fpsgen and MeowDB ('seen in gameplay') list 3.5 / 7.1; GTA6Info (DayOne), guiasgta6, Mobalytics, gta6codes and gta6heists list 4.5 / 6.1. Published as 4.5 / 6.1 (majority).

weapons.name: Vom Feuer VF-G1
notes: Joint-best assault-rifle accuracy (6.2, shared with the Hillinger Heathen) and best assault-rifle range (6.5).

weapons.name: AdB FRA
notes: Highest assault-rifle damage (5.8) and range (6.9).

weapons.name: Wortham W-22
notes: Weakest gun in the game (1.5 damage); small-game rifle, not a combat rifle. Some guides class it as a sniper rifle; guiasgta6 classes it as a tactical rifle — shipped as Tactical Rifles.

Accuracy contested by one source: MeowDB lists a 'modded' read of 8.8 accuracy / 5.0 handling / 7.8 range; GTA6Info, guiasgta6, HeistAtlas, Game8, GTABase and Exputer all list 8.0 / 5.8 / 7.0. Published as 8.0 / 5.8 / 7.0.
Price left null: Game8 lists $1,100 (single source); GTA6Info's price table omits the W-22 and GTABase lists no price.

weapons.name: Hawk & Little Mediator
notes: Sale price $450 is the first-visit / Gear Up mission price; standard price $900 (howtovideogame PS5 recording; Dexerto).

Magazine contested: GTA6Info, Dexerto and playday.one list 17; vAnother Level's stream read showed 24 on the menu. Ships as 17 with 24 as the extended magazine (24-rd $110, $55 sale; 33-rd $130 also published by RetroBroker).

weapons.name: Hillinger M306 TMR
weapons.unlock: Gold on all shooting range challenges

weapons.name: Fairview FF-SR

sources.name: The Games Wiki (Laird 350 sniper comparison table)

notes: Sniper-set conflict: GTA6Info (DayOne) lists 7.5 accuracy / 3.8 handling / 7.5 range; fpsgen, The Games Wiki and gamex list 8.3 / 2.9 / 8.4. Published as 8.3 / 2.9 / 8.4 (majority + store-screen claims).

weapons.name: Shrewsbury SM-69
weapons.unlock: Buy 2 more guns to unlock; Expanded Ammu-Nation stores only

sources.name: The Games Wiki (Laird 350 sniper comparison table)

notes: Sniper-set conflict: GTA6Info (DayOne) lists 7.6 accuracy / 4.0 handling / 7.5 range; fpsgen and The Games Wiki list 8.4 / 3.1 / 8.4. Published as 8.4 / 3.1 / 8.4 (majority + store-screen claims). A free unique SM-69 ('Killtelligence SM-69') is given by Bret on his first hunting quest — a variant, not this base gun.

weapons.name: Shrewsbury SMS-01
weapons.unlock: After Bret's ninth hunting quest; Expanded Ammu-Nation stores only

sources.name: The Games Wiki (Laird 350 sniper comparison table)

notes: Named without stats in GTA6Info's Weapons_List; stats from fpsgen and The Games Wiki, agreeing 6.8 / 8.6 / 3.3 / 8.4. gta6codes.fr also lists it as the most accurate gun (8.6) with range 8.4.
Magazine size and calibre not published in the sources checked — left null, never guessed.

weapons.name: Fortune & Son Laird 350

sources.name: The Games Wiki (Laird 350 sniper comparison table)

notes: Accuracy conflict — RESOLVED toward 8.8 (see addendum (b)): Dexerto, MeowDB ('seen in gameplay'), GrindStat, fpsgen ('every stat comes from the Ammu-Nation screens'), The Games Wiki ('as the store shows them for the stock guns'), libertycity and Power Up Gaming all list 8.8 accuracy / 3.6 handling / 8.4 range. GTA6Info's DayOne table alone lists 8.0 / 4.5 / 7.5 (its own 'Quick picks' section previously said 8.8). Published as 8.8 / 3.6 / 8.4. Cheapest sniper; most accurate gun in the store.

weapons.name: Fairview FF-50
weapons.unlock: Expanded Ammu-Nation stores only; requires bank account

sources.name: The Games Wiki (Laird 350 sniper comparison table)

notes: Highest-damage sniper (8.5). Accuracy contested: GTA6Info (DayOne) lists 7.0; fpsgen and The Games Wiki list 7.8; RetroBroker notes early captures show 7.8-8.5. Published as 7.8 (lower end of the observed range). Handling/range: GTA6Info lists 3.5 / 7.5; fpsgen, The Games Wiki and RetroBroker list 2.5 / 8.5.
Calibre: GTA6Info's table prints '.50 BFG', read as .50 BMG per RetroBroker.

weapons.name: Goodwin LMG 6
notes: Price single-source: Dexerto alone lists $15,250 ('price and stats confirmed from in-game shop screen'); GTA6Info's Best Weapons page says 'No published price yet' and its price table omits the LMG 6. Stats (6.8 / 2.8 / 2.8 / 6.5) agree across GTA6Info, IGN, guiasgta6 and Dexerto.

weapons.name: Hillinger Boomer
notes: Joint-highest damage with the GLR40 (9.2).

weapons.name: Deever Tech GLR40
notes: Price marked disputed (*) in GTA6Info's price table; Dexerto, guiasgta6, The Games Wiki and Exputer all list $15,500. One guide says the free GLR40 (Sunrise Motel store room, Tequesta) is not a unique weapon — it is the same base gun, free.

weapons.name: Hauners H-AT
notes: Highest damage rating in the game (9.6). Buyability contested: one guide says 'rockets cannot be bought'; Dexerto lists it as sold at Expanded Ammu-Nation stores for $16,000, and several guides report a free H-AT in the Balsero bunker (under an RV near Griffin Shooting Range).
